description: Search the connected user's Skwirl saves by keyword and meaning when the user wants to find something they saved. Returns relevance-ordered hits with title, summary (up to 140 characters) and note ID, or 'No matching saves.' Use concept words in query; limit is 1–20 (default 5), and optional status is unused or used. Open a relevant ID with get_skwirl_note; use recent_skwirl for newest saves or list_skwirl_mentions for named entities. Usage examples: search_skwirl({"query":"weeknight pasta","limit":5}); search_skwirl({"query":"agent memory","status":"unused"}). Returns text.

limit.description: Integer result count from 1 to 20; defaults to 5. Example: 5.

query.description: Nonempty string of concept words, names or the underlying problem, up to 200 characters. Try a second query if the first is weak. Example: weeknight pasta.

status.description: Optional exact status string: unused or used; omit for all saves. Example: unused.

name: search_skwirl
title: Search saved notes
